A Haloha is a simple, thought-provoking question that gives us an opportunity for self-reflection, imagination and creativity. Here are a few examples:


•	If I had the courage, I would  ____________________________
•	If my body could talk, it would tell me ___________________
•	You would never guess by looking at me that  ___________
•	I want to be remembered for ____________________________
•	My theme song should be _______________________________


HOW IT WORKS

1) Daily Haloha starts with you. 

Take a moment for yourself, each day, to consider the question.  This is your chance for self-reflection.

Remember, you only answer the day’s Haloha question once, so make it count! A Haloha is a chance to truly be yourself and express your thoughts honestly, because Halohas are anonymous and free of judgment. Once you fill in the blanks, you select a Mood color that best fits your Haloha. And then you’re ready to offer your personal Haloha to the rest of the world!

When you send your Haloha it's randomly and anonymously delivered to another person, somewhere in the world – and instantly you’ll get a Haloha back from another thoughtful and curious person.
